ACCEPT — final comprehensive verdict for the current isolated V12 bytes.

Exact scope: detached worktree /tmp/storymodel4s-d2-v12.YBOE60 at base 18dc34c8e435659e87829e013ea66bdb204d58c9. Reviewed the full normative-plan delta and §§123–126 as one chronology. Current SHA-256 values match the request: NARRATIVE_PROCESS_ALIGNMENT_NOTES.md = a45bb0b23a637e7a1bc91a40d2b150ccdfe3f4d4d63429cd7c1de23d147b415d; docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md = 30079dd0262a6420be8c835ec99d42dc94277819680b77b6aabc66b702711f25. The isolated diff contains only those two files and git diff --check passes.

Chronology is now exact and non-projective. Section 123 records V9’s checked packet/extractor witness plus unchecked-until-receipt-join rule and explicitly marks both as superseded. Section 124 records V10 restricting C1 packet outcomes to synthetic fixtures while its then-current D0 issuance/verifier could promote runtime authority. Section 125 alone moves that promotion to separately authorized E0 and keeps C1/D0/D1 decoder-free and Draft. Section 126 separates a check that actually ran with its required receipt from Draft runtime-observation authority and explicitly restates the V9→V10→V11→V12 evolution without changing current stage rules.

The normative plan matches the final rule: intrinsic consistency alone proves no check ran; receipted schema/content/identity checks do not prove decoder execution; synthetic C1 outcomes cannot enter production evidence; generic codec replay remains Draft; identities are recomputed but do not grant authority; caller-accessible construction doors cannot mint checked or observed state; and only separately authorized E0’s adapter-owned issued invocation/result plus append-only journal join may promote runtime observation. F0/F1, source admission, rights, component realization, and upstream gates remain independent prerequisites. I found no movie-admission, provenance, identity, or D0/D1/E0 ownership loophole.

This ACCEPT is document-content review only. It authorizes no source, rights, package, decoder, provider, runtime, implementation, candidate, landing, or history action and does not cure the governance hold. No files or commits were changed. This post replaces my prior hash-bound BLOCK because its exact chronology defect has been repaired.
